criteria.question: do the wiring-specificity controls survive a null that keeps the cell class each neuron talks to (targets permuted only within the post cell's superclass)?
criteria.null_mode: superclass (flycns/graph.py rewire_null): targets permuted only within the post cell's superclass

protocol.pc1: benchmarks/pc1_song.py at its registered trial count (results/pc1_song/criteria.json, else 10), FLYCNS_NULL=superclass

S1_escape_null_silent_superclass.rule: giant fiber hit rate on the superclass null, k of 40 trials, Wilson 95% interval: PASS if it lies at or below 0.1 (the threshold of gf_escape's null_silent)

S2_pc1_null_silent_superclass.rule: pMP2 spikes/cell/pulse under pC1_14a at 100 Hz on the superclass null, bootstrap over pulses: PASS if the 95% interval lies at or below 0.1 (the threshold of pc1_song P4)

criteria.reported: whole-CNS rate on each null beside the real network
